Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Share Family Photos

Actors Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh shared family photographs, including images of their daughter Dua, ahead of the expected arrival of their second child. The couple announced their second pregnancy earlier this year. The photographs were shared on Tuesday, with reports indicating they were taken in Mumbai. The images show the couple with their daughter, Dua Singh Padukone, who is celebrating her second birthday.
